android.desc:
Stop losing money to forgotten subscriptions and surprise charges. 💸

TrackAutopay is the smartest subscription tracker and bill reminder app that puts you in control of every recurring payment. 📲 

Whether it's Netflix, Spotify, gym memberships, insurance, rent, or SaaS tools — track all your subscriptions in one place and never miss a payment again. 🔄

🚀 WHY TRACKAUTOPAY?

★ TRACK ALL SUBSCRIPTIONS & BILLS 💳
Add every recurring payment — from streaming services to utility bills. 
See your total monthly and yearly spending at a glance. 
📊 Supports 24+ categories including entertainment, utilities, insurance, rent, health, shopping, and more.

★ SMART PAYMENT REMINDERS ⏰
Get notified before you get charged. 
🔔 Set custom reminder days and preferred notification times so you're never caught off guard by an unexpected renewal or late fee.

★ SPENDING INSIGHTS & ANALYTICS 📊
Understand where your money goes each month. 
See month-over-month spending trends, top categories, cost-per-day rankings, and identify subscriptions you can cancel to save money. 💡

★ AUTO-DETECT FROM YOUR BANK (Premium) 🏦
Connect your bank securely via Plaid and automatically discover recurring charges you may have forgotten. 
🔍 No more manually entering every subscription — let TrackAutopay find them for you.

★ BUDGET ALERTS & SPENDING FORECASTS 📉
Set monthly spending limits and get alerts when you're approaching your budget. ⚠️ View 6-month and 12-month spending projections to plan ahead and avoid overspending on subscriptions.

★ WHAT-IF SIMULATOR 🧠
Wondering how much you'd save by canceling a subscription? 💭 Use the built-in cancellation impact calculator to see exactly how it affects your monthly and yearly budget.

★ OVERLAP DETECTION 🔍
Find duplicate or redundant subscriptions eating into your budget. TrackAutopay identifies potential overlaps so you only pay for what you actually use.

★ EXPORT REPORTS 📁
Export your subscription data as CSV or PDF for personal records, tax filing, or expense reporting. 🧾 Keep a clean paper trail of all recurring payments.

🆓 FREE FEATURES

✓ Track up to 10 subscriptions
✓ 3 payment methods 💳
✓ Smart reminders 🔔
✓ Monthly spending overview 📊
✓ Dark mode 🌙
✓ Available in 6 languages 🌍

💎 PRO FEATURES

✓ Unlimited subscriptions & payment methods
✓ Advanced spending analytics dashboard 📊
✓ CSV & PDF export 📁
✓ Unlimited custom categories
✓ Flexible reminder timing ⏰
✓ Multi-device cloud sync ☁️
✓

show_hn.title: Show HN: I built an app to track Autopay bills and subscriptions in one place

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I built TrackAutoPay, a small app to help people track autopay bills and subscriptions in one place.

The idea came from my own frustration: I had subscriptions scattered across multiple cards and accounts, and no single place to see what renews when or how much I’m really spending each month.

What it does:
Track subscriptions and autopay bills
See monthly / yearly recurring spend
Get reminders before renewals
Spot unused or forgotten subscriptions

Right now, users manually add subscriptions, which keeps things simple and privacy-friendly. I’m exploring smarter detection later, but wanted to start with a transparent MVP.

Website: https://trackautopay.com
PlayStore: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.trackautopay.app

I’d really appreciate feedback from this community:
Would you trust a tool like this?
Manual entry vs bank/email parsing — what would you prefer?
What’s missing that would make this actually useful long-term?

Happy to answer questions and take criticism.

Thanks.
